251.translation: Then We revived you after your death that perhaps you would be grateful.
Every soul will taste death. Then to Us will you be returned.

252.translation: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].
You are not, [O Muḥammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman.

253.translation: And I am not one to drive away the believers.
And said, "I am your most exalted lord."

254.translation: [Pharaoh] said, "So who is the Lord of you two, O Moses?"
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

255.translation: And Allāh is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.
He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do."

256.translation: Then he desires that I should add more.
And they fall upon their faces weeping, and it [i.e., the Qur’ān] increases them in humble submission.

257.translation: And at night. Then will you not use reason?
Indeed, We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur’ān that you might understand.

258.translation: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Grand, the Exalted.
Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?

259.translation: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?

260.translation: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.
And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder for the righteous.

261.translation: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled.
And they say, "When is [the fulfillment of] this promise, if you should be truthful?"

262.translation: Indeed, it will be but one shout,
And what can make you know what that is?

263.translation: The sight [of the Prophet (ﷺ)] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].

264.translation: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter].
So the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home [corpses] fallen prone.

265.translation: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].
And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will be in despair.

266.translation: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.
And to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and to Allāh is the destination.

267.translation: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
And if they decide on divorce - then indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.

268.translation: And he [i.e., the dying one] is certain that it is the [time of] separation
Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."

269.translation: And they came to their father at night, weeping.
May the hands of Abū Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.

270.translation: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?

271.translation: And inform them about the guests of Abraham,
Say, [O Muḥammad], "Shall we [believers] inform you of the greatest losers as to [their] deeds?

272.translation: They who believe and do not mix their belief with injustice - those will have security, and they are [rightly] guided.
Say, [O Muḥammad], "On the Day of Conquest the belief of those who had disbelieved will not benefit them, nor will they be reprieved."

273.translation: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?
What is [the matter] with you? How do you judge?

274.translation: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Aware.
And He is the subjugator over His servants. And He is the Wise, the Aware.

275.translation: Guide us to the straight path -
And We would have guided them to a straight path.

276.translation: To Allāh is your return, and He is over all things competent."
And to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and Allāh is over all things competent.

277.translation: And He will leave it [i.e., the earth] a level plain;
Leave Me with the one I created alone

278.translation: And warn, [O Muḥammad], your closest kindred.
So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.

279.translation: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.
Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?

280.translation: O People of the Scripture, why do you disbelieve in the verses of Allāh while you witness [to their truth]?
They said, "Then bring him before the eyes of the people that they may testify."

281.translation: Did We not expand for you, [O Muḥammad], your breast?
And that within the breasts is obtained,

282.translation: Then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists.
And most of them believe not in Allāh except while they associate others with Him.

283.translation: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."
None will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant.

284.gloss: And We called out to him

284.translation: And when he came to it, he was called, "O Moses,

285.translation: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.
And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -

286.translation: [All] praise is [due] to Allāh, Lord of the worlds -
And praise to Allāh, Lord of the worlds.

287.translation: The people of Noah denied the messengers
And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders.

288.translation: Nor are the darknesses and the light,
And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?

289.translation: And admit them to Paradise, which He has made known to them.
And We admitted him into Our mercy. Indeed, he was of the righteous.

290.translation: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.
He said, "Indeed, with me you will never be able to have patience.

291.translation: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense -
As reward for what they used to do.

292.translation: That we may exalt You much
And exalt Him morning and afternoon.

293.translation: [Having been told], "Enter it in peace, safe [and secure]."

294.translation: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.
He will cry out for destruction

295.translation: And Our word [i.e., decree] has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,
And Allāh will establish the truth by His words, even if the criminals dislike it."

296.translation: He released the two seas, meeting [one another];
And when the seas are filled with flame

297.translation: And upon them and on ships you are carried.
So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place.

298.translation: Exalted is Allāh above what they describe,
Exalted is He and high above what they say by great sublimity.

299.translation: Then Allāh will punish him with the greatest punishment.
So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment,

300.translation: Taught to him by one intense in strength [i.e., Gabriel] -

301.translation: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]
And He is the subjugator over His servants. And He is the Wise, the Aware.

302.translation: That We may show you [some] of Our greater signs.
Say, [O Muḥammad], "My Lord, if You should show me that which they are promised,

303.translation: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,
And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.

304.translation: Then he turned back and was arrogant
Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.

305.translation: And landmarks. And by the stars they are [also] guided.
And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture that perhaps they would be guided.

306.translation: [It is] Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the settlement.
Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place.

307.translation: Then why, when it [i.e., the soul at death] reaches the throat
No! When it [i.e., the soul] has reached the collar bones

308.translation: And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],

309.translation: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
[They are] those who endured patiently and upon their Lord relied.

310.translation: He who fears [Allāh] will be reminded.
But only as a reminder for those who fear [Allāh] -

311.translation: No partner has He. And this I have been commanded, and I am the first [among you] of the Muslims."
And [warn of] the Day He will call them and say, "Where are My 'partners' which you used to claim?"

312.translation: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.
[He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Grand, the Exalted.

313.translation: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

314.translation: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,
Unquestionably, it is they who are the corrupters, but they perceive [it] not.

315.translation: And one who invites to Allāh, by His permission, and an illuminating lamp.
And what struck you on the day the two armies met [at Uḥud] was by permission of Allāh that He might make evident the [true] believers

316.translation: In the name of Allāh, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

317.translation: And the mountains will pass on, departing -
And the mountains are broken down, crumbling

318.translation: For wrongdoing on the part of the Jews, We made unlawful for them [certain] good foods which had been lawful to them, and for their averting from the way of Allāh many [people],
O Prophet, why do you prohibit [yourself from] what Allāh has made lawful for you, seeking the approval of your wives? And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

319.translation: And had not known what is my account.
He will be judged with an easy account

320.translation: And whether you die or are killed, unto Allāh you will be gathered.

321.translation: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals?
Be not haughty with me but come to me in submission [as Muslims].'"

322.gloss: So We gave him the glad tidings
322.translation: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.
So give them tidings of a painful punishment,

323.translation: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
He will surely cause them to enter an entrance with which they will be pleased, and indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Forbearing.

324.translation: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.
Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness..

325.translation: As guidance and mercy for the doers of good
Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

326.translation: And for divorced women is a provision according to what is acceptable - a duty upon the righteous.
Obedience and good words. And when the matter [of fighting] was determined, if they had been true to Allāh, it would have been better for them.

327.translation: Then, are we not to die
Indeed, you are to die, and indeed, they are to die.

328.translation: This is not but the word of a human being."
And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers.

329.translation: And when the wild beasts are gathered
On the Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful as a delegation

330.translation: For what sin she was killed
And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze.

331.translation: Gone from me is my authority."
Or do you have a clear authority?

332.translation: And indeed, they [i.e., the devils] avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided
Those who disbelieve and avert [people] from the way of Allāh - He will waste their deeds.

333.translation: From following me? Then have you disobeyed my order?"
So he [i.e., Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent, manifest.

334.translation: And whoever turned away after that - they were the defiantly disobedient.
So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allāh].

335.translation: And [We cursed them] for their disbelief and their saying against Mary a great slander
Whoever disbelieves - upon him is [the consequence of] his disbelief. And whoever does righteousness - they are for themselves preparing,

336.translation: Guide us to the straight path -
And We would have guided them to a straight path.

337.translation: So We saved him and his family, all,
[So mention] when We saved him and his family, all,

338.translation: Provided you with grazing livestock and children
As enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.

339.translation: [To whom Allāh will say], "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve,
So do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are [true] believers.

340.translation: Do you call upon Baʿl and leave the best of creators -
We have certainly created man in the best of stature;

341.translation: So taste My punishment and warning.
This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence.

342.translation: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,
[He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks.

343.translation: Look how they invent about Allāh untruth, and sufficient is that as a manifest sin.
And those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, and when they are angry, they forgive,

344.translation: Allāh will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which you used to differ."
[It is] so He will make clear to them [the truth of] that wherein they differ and so those who have disbelieved may know that they were liars.

345.translation: One of soundness. And he rose to [his] true form
The Most Merciful [who is] above the Throne established.

346.translation: Thus does Allāh make clear to you His verses [i.e., laws] that you might use reason.
And Allāh makes clear to you the verses [i.e., His rulings], and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

347.translation: And you are at that time looking on -
Who sees you when you arise

348.translation: Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed [i.e., tyrannized]."
And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride].

349.translation: So prostrate to Allāh and worship [Him].
And the stars and trees prostrate.

350.translation: As enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.
[As] enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.

351.translation: Indeed you, [O Muḥammad], are from among the messengers,

352.translation: We will make you recite, [O Muḥammad], and you will not forget,
[Allāh] will say, "Thus did Our signs come to you, and you forgot [i.e., disregarded] them; and thus will you this Day be forgotten."

353.translation: Abiding therein forever, they will not find a protector or a helper.
And Allāh is most knowing of your enemies; and sufficient is Allāh as an ally, and sufficient is Allāh as a helper.

354.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

355.translation: When We inspired to your mother what We inspired,
And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.

356.translation: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors -
But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors -

357.translation: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.
[And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."

358.translation: And [We cursed them] for their disbelief and their saying against Mary a great slander
O Mary, be devoutly obedient to your Lord and prostrate and bow with those who bow [in prayer]."

359.translation: And it is prohibited to [the people of] a city which We have destroyed that they will [ever] return
Have they not seen that We made [Makkah] a safe sanctuary, while people are being taken away all around them? Then in falsehood do they believe, and in the favor of Allāh they disbelieve?

360.translation: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,
And the sun and the moon are joined,

361.translation: Is it not [true] that every time they took a covenant a party of them threw it away? But, [in fact], most of them do not believe.
Then when He removes the adversity from you, at once a party of you associates others with their Lord

362.translation: Who sees you when you arise
Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little -

363.translation: Say, "Indeed, those who invent falsehood about Allāh will not succeed."
Look how they invent about Allāh untruth, and sufficient is that as a manifest sin.

364.translation: No! Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell],
No! Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder

365.translation: So turn away from them and wait. Indeed, they are waiting.
Then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists.

366.translation: Assuredly, it is they, in the Hereafter, who will be the losers.
And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers.

367.translation: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]
Descendants, some of them from others. And Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.

368.translation: And they who are observant of zakāh
And affection from Us and purity, and he was fearing of Allāh

369.translation: Then look how was the end of those who were warned -
So We took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers.

370.translation: There is, at its occurrence, no denial.

371.translation: Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers
And rely upon Allāh; and sufficient is Allāh as Disposer of affairs.

372.translation: Have you seen the one who forbids
They said, "Have we not forbidden you from [protecting] people?"

373.translation: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? He [i.e., Allāh] constructed it.
And We destroyed greater than them in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.

374.translation: That, then, is an unjust division.
Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.

375.translation: And We gave him good in this world, and indeed, in the Hereafter he will be among the righteous.
Whoever comes [at Judgement] with a good deed will have better than it, and they, from the terror of that Day, will be safe.

376.translation: But those who deny Our signs - We will progressively lead them [to destruction] from where they do not know.
So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed,

377.translation: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"
So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.

378.translation: Indeed, it will be but one shout,
And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.

379.translation: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.
[Allāh said], "O John, take the Scripture [i.e., adhere to it] with determination." And We gave him judgement [while yet] a boy

380.translation: Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."
And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.

381.translation: From the evil of that which He created

382.translation: [Allāh said], "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Knowing.
And We did certainly give the Children of Israel the Scripture and judgement and prophethood, and We provided them with good things and preferred them over the worlds.

383.translation: And ʿAad and Pharaoh and the brothers [i.e., people] of Lot

384.translation: Say, "Perhaps it is close behind you [i.e., very near] - some of that for which you are impatient.
For those it is expected that Allāh will pardon them, and Allāh is ever Pardoning and Forgiving.

385.translation: Taught to him by one intense in strength [i.e., Gabriel] -
[Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],

387.translation: They will murmur among themselves, "You remained not but ten [days in the world]."
He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected.

388.translation: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people.
[Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician.

389.translation: [They will be told], "Do not cry this Day for one destruction but cry for much destruction."

390.translation: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].
And [I swear] by Allāh, I will surely plan against your idols after you have turned and gone away."

391.translation: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.
And what you do not see

392.translation: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.
And [that] indeed, Our soldiers [i.e., the believers] will be those who overcome.

393.translation: And if We had made him [i.e., the messenger] an angel, We would have made him [appear as] a man, and We would have covered them with that in which they cover themselves [i.e., confusion and doubt].
He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time."

394.translation: And as for ʿAad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind
And in ʿAad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.

395.translation: The Most Merciful [who is] above the Throne established.

396.translation: And they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive
And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive

397.translation: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.
As if they were rubies and coral.

398.translation: And recite to them the news of Abraham,

399.translation: In which they will remain forever
[They will be] abiding therein forever. Indeed, Allāh has with Him a great reward.

400.translation: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful.
[Allāh] said, "After a little, they will surely become regretful."

401.translation: He will guide them and amend their condition
Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend."

402.translation: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].
[But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame."

403.translation: They will say, "[All belongs] to Allāh." Say, "Then how are you deluded?"
How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.

404.translation: So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the believers.
On the Day He will call you and you will respond with praise of Him and think that you had not remained [in the world] except for a little."

405.translation: And has the story of Moses reached you? -
Then at this statement do you wonder?

406.translation: And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?
Indeed, you approach men with desire, instead of women. Rather, you are a transgressing people."

407.translation: And obey Allāh and the Messenger that you may obtain mercy.
And, [O Muḥammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."

408.translation: And say, "This is not but obvious magic.
Then is this magic, or do you not see?

409.translation: Why, when you heard it, did not the believing men and believing women think good of themselves [i.e., one another] and say, "This is an obvious falsehood"?
And those who harm believing men and believing women for [something] other than what they have earned [i.e., deserved] have certainly borne upon themselves a slander and manifest sin.

410.translation: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allāh, so do not invoke with Allāh anyone.
O children of Adam, take your adornment [i.e., wear your clothing] at every masjid, and eat and drink, but be not excessive. Indeed, He likes not those who commit excess.

411.translation: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination
And to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and to Allāh is the destination.

412.translation: Degrees [of high position] from Him and forgiveness and mercy. And Allāh is ever Forgiving and Merciful.
And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - for them is forgiveness and noble provision.

413.translation: Certainly will the believers have succeeded:
He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself

414.translation: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways
Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.

415.translation: So do not obey the disbelievers, and strive against them with it [i.e., the Qur’ān] a great striving.
And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways. And indeed, Allāh is with the doers of good.

416.translation: And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire.
[It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,

417.translation: Or He could destroy them for what they earned; but He pardons much.
Then We forgave you after that so perhaps you would be grateful.

418.translation: That you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware.
And for all are degrees [i.e., positions resulting] from what they have done. And your Lord is not unaware of what they do.

419.translation: He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life."
A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.

420.translation: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,
And the sun and the moon are joined,

421.translation: And the people of Abraham and the people of Lot
The people of Lot denied the messengers

422.translation: And We raised him to a high station.
And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near -

423.translation: Give tidings to the hypocrites that there is for them a painful punishment -
And Allāh will surely make evident those who believe, and He will surely make evident the hypocrites.

424.translation: Certainly were there in Joseph and his brothers signs for those who ask, [such as]

And We gave to him [i.e., Abraham] Isaac and Jacob - all [of them] We guided. And Noah, We guided before; and among his descendants, David and Solomon and Job and Joseph and Moses and Aaron. Thus do We reward the doers of good.

425.translation: And when the messengers came to the family of Lot,
And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.

426.translation: So by your Lord, We will surely question them all
And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.

427.translation: And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.
Except his wife." We [i.e., Allāh] decreed that she is of those who remain behind.

428.translation: That He should establish the truth and abolish falsehood, even if the criminals disliked it.
And do not mix the truth with falsehood or conceal the truth while you know [it].

429.translation: And Thamūd - and He did not spare [them] -

430.translation: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,

431.translation: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
[To whom Allāh will say], "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve,

432.translation: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars
And We have placed within the heaven great stars and have beautified it for the observers.

433.translation: And those who are in their testimonies upright
[He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Grand, the Exalted.

434.translation: And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near -
And [you will obtain] another [favor] that you love - victory from Allāh and an imminent conquest; and give good tidings to the believers.

435.translation: Indeed, they are planning a plan,
And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm.

436.translation: They said while approaching them, "What is it you are missing?"
And [mention] the Day He will call them and say, "What did you answer the messengers?"

437.translation: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except Iblees; he refused.
Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words, and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful.

438.translation: And when they [i.e., its inhabitants] perceived Our punishment, at once they fled from it.
Then, did the people of the cities feel secure from Our punishment coming to them at night while they were asleep?

439.translation: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,

440.translation: Between them is a barrier so neither of them transgresses.
Wherein they abide eternally. They will not desire from it any transfer.

441.translation: And if they dispute with you, then say, "Allāh is most knowing of what you do.
And [that is so] those who dispute concerning Our signs may know that for them there is no place of escape.

442.translation: There is no blame upon you for entering houses not inhabited in which there is convenience for you. And Allāh knows what you reveal and what you conceal.

And when you travel throughout the land, there is no blame upon you for shortening the prayer, [especially] if you fear that those who disbelieve may disrupt [or attack] you. Indeed, the disbelievers are ever to you a clear enemy.

443.translation: They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples.
[This is] the established way of Allāh with those who passed on before; and you will not find in the way of Allāh any change.

444.translation: And Zechariah and John and Jesus and Elias - and all were of the righteous.
That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute.

445.translation: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.
Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?

446.translation: And untie the knot from my tongue

447.translation: Those who fulfill the covenant of Allāh and do not break the contract,
And how could you take it while you have gone in unto each other and they have taken from you a solemn covenant?

448.translation: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.
Unquestionably, it is they who are the corrupters, but they perceive [it] not.

449.translation: Is the male for you and for Him the female?
Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?

450.translation: Then Allāh will punish him with the greatest punishment.
Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.

451.translation: Is the male for you and for Him the female?
And [by] He who created the male and female,

452.translation: It is You we worship and You we ask for help.
O My servants who have believed, indeed My earth is spacious, so worship only Me.

453.translation: Then how [will it be] when the angels take them in death, striking their faces and their backs?
Say, "The angel of death who has been entrusted with you will take you. Then to your Lord you will be returned."

454.translation: Allāh - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining.
They are [in fact] dead, not alive, and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected.

455.translation: When two parties among you were about to lose courage, but Allāh was their ally; and upon Allāh the believers should rely.
[We revealed it] lest you say, "The Scripture was only sent down to two groups before us, but we were of their study unaware,"

456.translation: Then let mankind look at his food -
Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.

457.translation: And whoever strives only strives for [the benefit of] himself. Indeed, Allāh is Free from need of the worlds.
To Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. Indeed, Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.

458.translation: He will say, "By Allāh, you almost ruined me.
And if We had not strengthened you, you would have almost inclined to them a little.

459.translation: But as for those who disbelieved and denied Our verses and the meeting of the Hereafter, those will be brought into the punishment [to remain].
Whoever should hope for the meeting with Allāh - indeed, the term [decreed by] Allāh is coming. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

460.translation: While Allāh encompasses them from behind.
But as for he who is given his record behind his back,

461.translation: And rely upon Allāh; and sufficient is Allāh as Disposer of affairs.
But your people have denied it while it is the truth. Say, "I am not over you a manager [i.e., authority]."

462.translation: And has listened [i.e., responded] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse.

463.translation: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.
And We saved those who believed and used to fear Allāh.

464.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], "My Lord, if You should show me that which they are promised,
And whether [or not] We take you away [in death], indeed, We will take retribution upon them.

465.translation: The word [i.e., decree] will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."
To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.

466.translation: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.
As guidance and a reminder for those of understanding.

467.translation: And the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allāh].
So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allāh].

468.translation: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]
And We have certainly given you, [O Muḥammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great Qur’ān.

469.translation: Nor are the darknesses and the light,
It is He who confers blessing upon you, and His angels [ask Him to do so] that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light. And ever is He, to the believers, Merciful.

470.translation: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire
And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger [i.e., Moses],

471.translation: And upon them and on ships you are carried.
[Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.

472.translation: [Pharaoh] said, "Then what is the case of the former generations?"
Then We produced after them a generation of others.

473.translation: Indeed, Allāh has cursed the disbelievers and prepared for them a Blaze.
Those [who do so] are the ones that Allāh has cursed, so He deafened them and blinded their vision.

474.translation: Nor did we used to feed the poor.
Or a needy person in misery

475.translation: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?

476.translation: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],
O Mary, be devoutly obedient to your Lord and prostrate and bow with those who bow [in prayer]."

477.gloss: And surely, We will let them taste
477.translation: And We will surely let them taste the nearer punishment short of the greater punishment that perhaps they will return [i.e., repent].

477.gloss: But surely We will cause to taste
477.translation: But We will surely cause those who disbelieve to taste a severe punishment, and We will surely recompense them for the worst of what they had been doing.

478.translation: And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead,
When his Lord said to him, "Submit," he said, "I have submitted [in Islām] to the Lord of the worlds."

479.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,
Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure

480.translation: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.
But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever, of him, Seeing.

481.translation: And the sun and the moon are joined,
Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.

482.translation: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
And gathered for Solomon were his soldiers of the jinn and men and birds, and they were [marching] in rows

483.translation: And We made it a deterrent punishment for those who were present and those who succeeded [them] and a lesson for those who fear Allāh.
So if you, [O Muḥammad], gain dominance over them in war, disperse by [means of] them those behind them that perhaps they will be reminded.

484.translation: But my invitation increased them not except in flight [i.e., aversion].
And man supplicates for evil [when angry] as he supplicates for good, and man is ever hasty.

485.translation: And We raised him to a high station.
He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.

486.translation: And the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allāh].
So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allāh].

487.translation: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.
And He subjected for you the sun and the moon, continuous [in orbit], and subjected for you the night and the day.

488.translation: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.
Except one who steals a hearing and is pursued by a clear burning flame.

489.translation: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire
Thus. And We had encompassed [all] that he had in knowledge.

490.translation: Near it is the Garden of Refuge [i.e., Paradise] -
Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.

491.translation: And they conspired an immense conspiracy
And they [i.e., the disbelievers] planned, but Allāh planned. And Allāh is the best of planners.

492.translation: And [that] Allāh may aid you with a mighty victory.
When the victory of Allāh has come and the conquest,

493.translation: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."
[And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.

494.translation: Indeed, they were not expecting an account
What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allāh [due] grandeur

495.translation: He created the heavens and earth in truth and formed you and perfected your forms; and to Him is the [final] destination.
Who perfected everything which He created and began the creation of man from clay.

496.translation: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].
Not equal are the blind and the seeing,

497.translation: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.
And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life

498.translation: [But] Allāh mocks them and prolongs them in their transgression [while] they wander blindly.
And no messenger would come to them except that they ridiculed him.

499.translation: Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided.
Indeed, those who purchase disbelief [in exchange] for faith - never will they harm Allāh at all, and for them is a painful punishment.

500.translation: In them are good and beautiful women -
Who is it that would loan Allāh a goodly loan so He will multiply it for him and he will have a noble reward?
